create_quest_easy_env: create a MiniHackQuestEasy environment with 500 max steps and autopickup enabled
create_quest_medium_env: create a MiniHackQuestMedium environment with a human knight character and 1000 max steps
create_quest_hard_env: create a MiniHackQuestHard environment with 1000 max steps for advanced quest gameplay
register_quest_envs: register MiniHack-Quest-Easy-v0, MiniHack-Quest-Medium-v0, and MiniHack-Quest-Hard-v0 environment IDs
customize_quest_env_kwargs: customize a quest environment by passing max_episode_steps or autopickup kwargs to the constructor
